page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with running head at top and page number at top left. Letter closes with date and signature, then the epistle heading, a summary line, address line, and the start of the next letter. No margin notes.

main_text.p: teriqve amici longa mei oblivione capti sint, & nullis officiis meum promoverint negotium: modo scribo ad ipsum Eminentissimum Cardinalem Mazarinum, ut stet promissis, & una ad eundem literas commendationis mitto, uti per literas quoque certiores facio De le Jay & Vitray: interea dum responsum expecto rei hujus, me tuis bea [?] praeceptis.
main_text.head: EPIST. LXVIII.
Leo Allatius Johanni Morino. Nonnulla, quæ ad figuram Ecclesiarum apud Græcos & eorum Liturgias spectant, discutiuntur, de Pœnitentiæ ritu apud Græcos etiam nonnulla.
main_text.p: Clarissimo & Doctissimo Viro Johanni Mo-rino Leo Allatius F.
ERuditissimam Epistolam tuam, in qua de veteris Ecclesiæ partibus plura doctissi-

page.notes: The first word of the page, "teriqve", is a fragment of a word cut at the left edge of the line and is kept as printed. "bea" is uncertain, marked [?]. The initial E of the final paragraph is a large letter joined to "Ruditissimam". The running head and "Datum"/"A. D.M.DC." lines are printed in small capitals and italics as shown.
